puzzles.solution: spin only the middle box so the striped drops onto the base; bounce it for fruit, then break the base
puzzles.wrongOrder: letting the striped come low and spinning it from the side
puzzles.loss: up to 10 fruit; box count unaffected

puzzles.summary: closed-court wall with opposite instructions per goal
puzzles.solution: all-box: break all 10; blue gem: dash-jump over or bounce once on the top-row striped
puzzles.wrongOrder: a short jump that clips the wall during a blue-gem run

puzzles.solution: stomp the turtle to flip it, jump on its belly, spin at the apex
puzzles.wrongOrder: spinning the turtle (hurt by spikes, or it flies away once flipped)

puzzles.solution: use the bounce, then spin the arrow box
puzzles.wrongOrder: bouncing on it and moving on

puzzles.summary: ostrich ledges and the ground trio
puzzles.solution: dash-jump onto each ostrich before it ducks, take the ledge boxes, then drop back for the three ground boxes
puzzles.wrongOrder: approaching slowly (ostrich ducks) or forgetting the ground trio
puzzles.loss: ledge boxes for this attempt; D2 advises losing a life to retry from X-b

puzzles.summary: Nitro credit from the green switch at the course end
puzzles.solution: survive past the Nitros and stomp the green ! on the final platform

observations: Every new crate behaviour first appears alone on solid ground: ? box, striped sandwich, stack, then mud stepping boxes.
Main course density 10/14/6; the 10-box wall is a third of the main count; the secret course (27) nearly equals the main course (30).
No 1UP boxes: every life is in a ? box at a risky or hidden place (over Nitros, ostrich ledge, above a turtle, in the bonus).
Crates double as traversal tools: mud stepping boxes, the stack's striped top, the secret arrow.
Enemies are placed as tools next to crates (turtle springboard, ostrich platforms).
Explosives are confined to the optional secret course, with the green switch at its exit.
Checkpoints: C1 where the secret rejoins, C2 directly before the wall, the secret C after its easy first third.
Count traps concentrate in the optional route: arrow box, timed ostrich ledges, ground trio passed underneath.
The blue gem turns the wall from 'break' into 'avoid'; a striped crate in its top row is the intended stepping stone and the court prevents bypassing.
